meta.name: Memphis Solar
meta.author: Survey Site Sim (built-in)
meta.notes: The site that ships with the game (v1.56), exported so you can see how a finished site is laid out: conexes, storage, forklifts, the delivery semi and the full T1–T15 mission chain with each 'What to use' card. Save makes your own copy.

missions.title: Stake the site LOD perimeter
missions.brief: Before anybody moves dirt we need the whole job site limits staked. Run the LOD all the way around the field, just inside the treeline — it's a big loop, so take the UTV.

missions.title: Lay out the primary silt fence
missions.brief: LOD looks good. Now the primary silt fence — same loop, offset just inside your LOD line.

missions.title: Silt fence around the pond
missions.brief: Primary fence looks good. Before the road crew starts pushing gravel, the pond needs protecting — ring it with silt fence up on the bank so nothing washes in.

missions.title: Lay out the edge of road
missions.brief: Fence is in. Now the access roads — stake both edges of every new gravel road: the spine south off the farm road to the inverter pad, the cross road east and up to the substation, the drive down from our yard, and the gravel over the farm road at both ends. Green ribbon, paint EOR. Once it's staked the road crew lays gravel.

missions.title: Buggy topo of the array
missions.brief: Engineering needs ground shots for the pile heights. Put the rod back on the UTV mount (G), make sure the base is on, and drive the buggy over every topo point on your map — it shoots them as you roll through.

missions.title: Lay out the LBD piles
missions.brief: Topo's in. Now the LBD piles — two piles per LBD. Nails & tassel only (job box behind the break room), blue tassel. Zero the rod out on every point, it's tight work. Pile crew drives them, then the LBD racks go on.

missions.title: Lay out the inverter piles
missions.brief: Inverter piles next — ten of them on the pad at the south-west end. Nails & tassel, orange tassel. Same deal, zero out on every one.

missions.title: Lay out the AC collection run
missions.brief: Piles are marked, so now the AC collection line — from the inverter pad, up the west side and across the north end to the substation. Pink ribbon, paint AC. The trencher buries it once you're done.

missions.title: Lay out the DC cable runs
missions.brief: Now the DC runs from the inverter out to both LBD banks. Orange ribbon, paint DC. When they're in we set the inverter and the racking piles start going up.

missions.title: Locate the AC cable
missions.brief: With piles going in everywhere, we can't have anybody hitting cable. Walk the AC route from the inverter pad to the substation and flag it with red pin flags — just the flags, no line. Skip where it crosses the roads. Those flags stay put so everybody knows to watch out.

missions.title: Locate the DC cables
missions.brief: AC's flagged. Same thing for both DC runs, inverter out to the LBD banks — red pin flags, no line, skip the road crossings. Then the racking crew can pound away without hitting anything.

missions.title: Mark the trees in the panel rows
missions.brief: Hey, I was looking at my drone pictures and I think some trees might be in the way of some panels. Grab red spray paint from the job box behind the break room and go put a red X on every one of them — your rod will beep you to the right trees. Once they're all marked the tree crew cuts 'em down.

missions.title: Help Becky with the delivery
missions.brief: Last one for now — Becky, our warehouse manager, is having an issue with a delivery. She's at the storage conex out behind the break room. Go see what she needs.
